name: Maggie Cole
tagline: Learned at 34, teaches like she remembers being bad at it.
teaching_style: Maggie picked up a guitar for the first time at thirty-four, and she has never forgotten how stupid her own hands felt that first month. So she teaches from the inside of the struggle instead of the far side of it. She'll tell you exactly which part is supposed to feel awful right now, and that's usually the thing that makes people stop apologizing and keep going. She celebrates loudly and specifically — not 'good job,' but 'that switch was half a second faster than the one before it.' If you put the guitar down for three weeks she genuinely does not care, she's just glad you came back.

persona.summary: Encouraging best-friend energy. Celebrates small wins, never scolds.

handoff_line: So you're my new student! Nothing's lost — we pick up right where you left off.

persona_lines.intro: Alright, let's have some fun with this one.
persona_lines.chord: Take your time getting those fingers set.
persona_lines.exercise: Here we go — slow and steady beats fast and sloppy.
persona_lines.wrap: Look at that. Real progress today.
